text:
alex: Heads up, ran into a KV cache layout mismatch when rolling a quantized variant across hosted/dedicated/private. Need a minimal compatibility contract for probes + safe invalidation.

maria: What breaks exactly? corruption or just lookup mismatch?

alex: Lookup mismatch. Old layout: `pref:<tenant>:<model>:<seq>`. New quantized runtime writes chunked keys, so lookups return wrong prefixes -> inference falls back and latencies spike while cache rebuilds.

chao: Two low-friction approaches: 1) capability discovery at connect-time, 2) bumpable namespace token so layout changes are namespace switches.

olivia: Private installs can't call control plane for capability discovery, so we need a bundle-manifest or local probe.

chao: Proposal: tiny runtime probe API `POST /probe` returning capability flags (kv_layout version, supports_namespace_token). Clients/gateways call it before routing traffic. For hosted/dedicated, control plane can also push manifests. For private, bake manifest into deployment and run same probe locally.

maria: For invalidation, prefer `BUMP_NAMESPACE` over global purge. Implement `ns_token = sha256(model+layout+variant)` and prefix keys: `ns:<token>:pref:...`. Old keys become unreachable; async GC can clean them.

olivia: Security: probe endpoint must be authenticated and not leak tenant data. Return only enums/flags, e.g. `{"kv_layout":"v2","supports_namespace_token":true}`. No keys or tenant IDs.

alex: Draft probe payload I sketched:

client -> runtime:
{
  "client":"gateway",
  "model_variant":"redwood/quant-x86-v2",
  "expected_kv_layout":"v1"
}

runtime -> client:
{
  "kv_layout":"v2",
  "namespace_token":"sha256:abcd...",
  "action":"BUMP_NAMESPACE"  // enum: NO_OP | BUMP_NAMESPACE | FORCE_INVALIDATE
}

maria: +1 to enums, and add `opt_in_probe_on_startup` for private installs (default false).

chao: Implementation note: keep probe logic in runtime binary to avoid control-plane dependency. Hosted/dedicated can mirror manifest for rollout coordination. Private: manifest baked in or delivered via airgap bundle.

alex: Action items: I'll open RFC with probe API spec, namespace-token scheme, GC guidance, migration checklist.

maria: I'll add e2e test: quantized flip -> namespace bump -> no cross-tenant collisions and traces show token swap.

chao: I'll prototype a tiny probe handler and push PoC.

deploy-bot: Deploy successful: runtime/probe-poc -> staging (rev f1d2) :rocket:

alex: Thanks all, will tag reviewers once RFC draft is up. :memo:
